name: Salary Slip Shortfall Hours Caculation
Attendance Late Entry / Early Exit Hours Calculation
test
script:
total_shortfall_hours = 0

attendances = frappe.get_all(
    "Attendance",
    filters={
        "employee": doc.employee,
        "attendance_date": ["between", [doc.start_date, doc.end_date]],
        "docstatus": 1
    },
    fields=[
        "name", "in_time", "out_time", "status",
        "shift", "attendance_date", "late_entry", "early_exit"
    ]
)

for att in attendances:
    if att.status in ["Absent", "Half Day"]:
        continue

    if not att.shift or not att.in_time or not att.out_time:
        continue

    shift = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", att.shift)

    shift_start = frappe.utils.get_datetime(str(att.attendance_date) + " " + str(shift.start_time))
    shift_end = frappe.utils.get_datetime(str(att.attendance_date) + " " + str(shift.end_time))

    in_time = frappe.utils.get_datetime(att.in_time)
    out_time = frappe.utils.get_datetime(att.out_time)

    late_entry_hours = 0
    early_exit_hours = 0

    if att.late_entry and in_time > shift_start:
        late_entry_seconds = (in_time - shift_start).total_seconds()
        late_entry_hours = round(late_entry_seconds / 3600, 2)

    if att.early_exit and out_time < shift_end:
        early_exit_seconds = (shift_end - out_time).total_seconds()
        early_exit_hours = round(early_exit_seconds / 3600, 2)

    day_shortfall = late_entry_hours + early_exit_hours
    total_shortfall_hours = total_shortfall_hours + day_shortfall

    actual_worked_hours = (out_time - in_time).total_seconds() / 3600
    half_day_threshold = shift.half_day_threshold or 0

    if actual_worked_hours < half_day_threshold:
        shortfall_from_half_day = round(half_day_threshold - actual_worked_hours, 2)
        total_shortfall_hours = total_shortfall_hours + shortfall_from_half_day

doc.custom_working_hours_shortfall = round(total_shortfall_hours, 2)

script:
sender = frappe.db.get_value("Email Account", "Accounts", "email_id") customers = frappe.get_all( "Customer", filters={"custom_send_weekly_ledger_balance": 1}, fields=["name", "customer_name"] ) frappe.log_error(f"Weekly Ledger: Customers found - {len(customers)}") for cust in customers: cust_name = cust.customer_name contact_name = frappe.db.get_value( "Dynamic Link", {"link_doctype": "Customer", "link_name": cust.name}, "parent" ) frappe.log_error(f"contact_name: {contact_name}") if contact_name: email = frappe.db.get_value("Contact", contact_name, "email_id") if not email: frappe.log_error(f"Email not found for customer: {cust_name}") continue frappe.log_error(f"Processing customer: {cust_name}, Email: {email}") balance = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT SUM(debit) - SUM(credit) FROM `tabGL Entry` WHERE party_type='Customer' AND party=%s """, cust.name)[0][0] or 0 if balance <=1000: continue message = f""" Dear {cust_name},

This is to inform you that your account with us reflects a debit balance of Rs.{balance} as on {frappe.utils.today()}

We kindly request you to release the due payments at the earliest to keep your account in good standing. If you have already made the transfer, please share the UTR details to help us reconcile our records.

For any clarification regarding your ledger statement, feel free to contact us.

Best regards,
Ravi Products """ frappe.sendmail( recipients=[email], sender=sender, subject="Weekly Ledger Balance Statement (Test)", message=message )
